first_appearance_definition: The first visible portion within the clip that is identifiable and can be temporally matched to that subject; frame numbering starts at 0.

entities.name: teal stadium seating
entities.identification: Teal tiered seating distributed around the turf, with gray passageways between sections.

entities.name: stadium roof and trusses
entities.identification: The large-span light-gray canopy above the stands, with some dark support outlines.

entities.name: pink-purple illuminated racing gate set
entities.identification: A set of pink-purple illuminated frame-shaped structures along the distant sideline, excluding Object L and Object M.

entities.name: green stadium turf
entities.identification: The broad, approximately flat green area at the center of the stadium, with some light-brown areas and variations in brightness.

entities.name: gray sideline passageway
entities.identification: The gray strip-shaped pavement between the turf and the stands, which meets at an angled corner near the base of Object M and widens there.

entities.name: Object L
entities.identification: A white-pink pentagonal thick-framed racing gate on the turf, hollow in the middle, with pink supports at the bottom.

entities.name: Object M
entities.identification: A tower-shaped racing gate along the sideline, with cyan-blue illuminated column structures and a passage opening beneath a wide white-pink top.

entities.name: stadium floodlight strip
entities.identification: Rows of bright white lights and localized clusters of intense light along the roof edge and above the stands.

entities.name: upper-level black display screen
entities.identification: A nearly rectangular dark screen surface near the upper-level stands, with light-colored text-like bright shapes and a circular bright pattern.

entities.name: light-colored railing
entities.identification: Light-colored slender rod-like structures extending along the edges of seating sections, passageways, and platforms.

entities.name: teal low sideline wall
entities.identification: A teal opaque low wall strip extending along the lower edge of the stands and the gray sideline passageway.

entities.name: distant dark standing human figure
entities.identification: A group of background people in the distance on the turf, including at least two small, dark, upright human figures separated from each other.
